_comment: Per-engine profiles for unreal/VIVID2Env. 'vivid2 unreal setup --engine <ver>' renders VIVID2Env.uproject from VIVID2Env/VIVID2Env.uproject.template.json plus 'extra_plugins'. Fill plugin_zip.url/sha256/size after uploading a zip made with 'vivid2 unreal pack-plugin'.

5.7.notes: Upstream Project AirSim builds for 5.7 as-is. VIVID 2 maps are authored in 5.8; 5.7 users run packaged environment builds.

5.8.notes: Project AirSim needs the UE 5.8 compatibility patch (or the prebuilt plugin zip).
